ABOUT GEORGIAN



Georgian is a Toronto-based venture capital firm that partners with high-growth technology companies across cybersecurity, AI software, robotics, defense. We manage about $6B in assets and we have invested in more than 80 companies that we support with capital and technical capability.



Our in-house AI lab works directly with portfolio companies to provide a differentiated experience across the investment lifecycle, and drives the adoption of AI for our internal operations.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE



Are you an aspiring AI Engineer eager to gain real-world impact and learn how to push AI's boundaries? Imagine diving into diverse, cutting-edge AI problems across multiple high-growth companies with the support of a leading VC firm. That's Georgian.



We're not your typical VC. Georgian's unique R&D team partners directly with our portfolio companies, providing the technical horsepower and strategic guidance to help accelerate their AI initiatives. We also play a critical role in our investment process, conducting deep technical diligence to identify promising AI-driven businesses.



Think of it as working in a dynamic startup environment, but without the inherent risks of a single venture. You'll tackle fascinating challenges, meet and potentially work with brilliant founders and CTOs, and try to help unearth the next generation of industry leaders. It's a fun, engaging, and highly impactful way to build your career.




WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



Georgian's mission is to empower the world's leading B2B software companies with an unfair advantage, accelerating their participation in the digital economy. As an AI Engineer Intern on our R&D team, you'll support this mission by contributing to cutting-edge machine learning projects. You'll assist in bringing machine learning expertise directly to our portfolio companies' most pressing challenges, helping them build and scale potentially transformative AI products. You'll also contribute to our investment process technical diligence, helping us identify innovative and technically sound companies.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN & DELIVER



 - Support AI system development. Assist in building LLM agents, Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and fine‑tuned domain‑specific models under guidance; help implement workflows with frameworks like LangChain/LlamaIndex/PydanticAI.

 - Contribute to portfolio projects. Support Georgian "strike teams" embedded in portfolio companies; assist with code implementation, testing, and documentation.

 - Technical analysis & documentation. Help convert technical concepts into clear documentation; support preparation of demos and presentations for stakeholders.

 - Hands‑on R&D support. Assist in rapid prototyping, run experiments and ablation studies, contribute to internal tech notes and documentation.

 - Support AI roadmap development. Help gather requirements in discovery workshops, assist in documenting technical specifications and implementation plans.

 - Contribute to safety & governance. Assist in implementing evaluation pipelines and testing frameworks to keep models reliable and compliant.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR




IDEAL ATTRIBUTES

 - Education & Experience: Currently pursuing or recently completed a Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline with a focus on machine learning, optimization theory, or related areas.

 - Hands-On Foundation: Familiarity with deep learning toolkits such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. Understanding of GenAI, LLM tooling and Context Engineering fundamentals.

 - Software Development: Proficiency in Python and foundational software development skills, enabling you to write clean, efficient code.

 - Problem Formulation & Communication: The ability to understand applied research problems, assist in designing experiments, implement solutions, and clearly document findings for diverse audiences with varying technical backgrounds.

 - Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work on team projects, collaborate effectively with technical groups, and communicate progress to mentors and stakeholders.




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience contributing to open-source AI/ML-related projects or research papers.

 - Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) for MLOps and model deployment.

 - Exposure to specific industry verticals relevant to Georgian's portfolio (e.g., vertical SaaS, cybersecurity, healthcare tech, fintech).




CULTURAL ATTRIBUTES WE LOVE



 - High ambition & agency: You're allergic to incrementalism and thrive in low‑structure, high‑ownership settings.

 - Insatiable curiosity: You debug the root cause and ask why until everyone else gets annoyed—in a good way.

 - Team over ego: You amplify colleagues and founders alike, seeing leverage in elevating the collective.

 - Commercial storytelling: You speak with brevity and distill complexity so a time‑starved CEO instantly sees value.




HIRING PROCESS



We don't hire like a MAG7 or scale up — in fact we rarely hire compared to them.



You shouldn't expect a cookie-cutter high-volume hiring process with us — but a more boutique one that allows you to see a lot of the organization before joining us.



We build a thesis in what an individual brings to our very small team, versus simply matching qualifications:

 1. 30‑min intro (values & motivations)

 2. 60‑min technical interview (ML fundamentals & problem‑solving)

 3. Project discussion with team members




POSITION STATUS

 

This posting represents an active, future internship vacancy on our team. We will be interviewing for this role in early 2027.

 


OUR COMMITMENT TO ACCESSIBILITY



Georgian is dedicated to building an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We provide reasonable accommodations throughout our recruitment process to ensure every candidate has the opportunity to perform at their best. If you require any specific accommodations at any stage, please reach out to us at peopleteam [at]  georgian.io.




USE OF AI



Innovation is at our core and we use artificial intelligence (AI) to support parts of our hiring process, such as screening and evaluating applications. These tools are designed to assist - not replace - human decision making and all final hiring decisions are made by our team.  We regularly review our AI tools to help promote fairness and reduce the risk of unintended bias. If you have any questions about how we use AI in our process or would like more information, please contact us at careers [at] georgian.io.

THE ROLE:

Beacon acquires vertical market software companies and brings them onto a common operating standard. Integration is the function that runs the window between close and steady state, coordinating IT, Finance, GTM, Legal, and HR so that a newly acquired company lands cleanly rather than by improvisation.

You will run that window. Each integration is a fixed, fast-moving program with a defined start and a defined handoff, and you will be the person holding the plan, the cadence, and the escalations across every function involved. This is a hands-on role. You will drive the plan and you will do work inside it.




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Run integrations from close to handoff. Own the integration plan for each acquisition: scope, sequencing, owners, and dates across every function. Drive the recurring cadence, keep the plan current, and land the handoff on time.

Be the coordination point for the acquired company. Work directly with the GM and their team through their first weeks inside Beacon. Translate between how they operate today and how Beacon operates, and make sure nothing lands on them twice or not at all.

Move companies onto the Beacon standard. Identity, devices, security baselines, and core business systems. You will partner with IT, Security, and the systems owners to sequence the migrations and to unblock them when they stall.

Hold the line on status. Report progress honestly to leadership, including the parts that are behind. Escalate early and with a recommendation attached rather than late and with a surprise.

Run and sharpen the playbook. Each integration should be faster and cleaner than the last. Find the steps that keep breaking, fix them in the playbook, and make the improvement stick across the next one.




REQUIRED:

 - 5+ years in project or program management, running cross-functional programs end to end

 - Experience coordinating across IT, Finance, GTM, Legal, and HR, or an equivalent set of functions with competing priorities

 - Comfort with technical systems: identity, device management, and core SaaS platforms. You do not need to configure them, but you need to follow the work and ask sharp questions

 - Experience building process, templates, and structure where none existed

 - Strong written communication. Much of this job is a clear status update landing in the right inbox at the right time

 - A bias for action. You would rather move something forward than perfect the plan

 - The agility to adapt when a program changes shape mid-stream, and the confidence to get hands-on when it needs you


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Post-close M&A integration experience, in-house or in advisory

 - Exposure to IAM, MDM, or SSO rollouts

 - Exposure to SOC 2, ISO 27001, or SOX ITGC programs

 - Automation experience

 - A habit of spotting the smarter way to do something and then doing it


Our Values at Beacon Software

 - Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time.

 The brand you join is an established product with a real audience and channels already in place, so this is not a launch. Email and lifecycle marketing sits at the center of the work, with conversion rate optimization alongside it, and content, social, and automation around both.
 💡 Interested in applying? 
 🔍 Please read/follow the next steps outlined in "How to Apply" at the bottom of this listing.
 Attention to detail is one of our core values ! This is your chance to stand out :)
 To love this role, here’s the type of person you are:
 Hands-on operator. You enjoy doing the work yourself rather than briefing it out.
 AI-first workflow is your bar. A campaign that used to take a small team a week should ship in a day or two through your AI workflow, without the output looking generic.
 Velocity matters to you. Success in the first 60 to 90 days is measured by acceleration of output, how many things you ship, how quickly you learn from them, and what you do with the learnings.
 Self-directed . You bring ideas to leadership based on data. You do not wait for someone to tell you what to test next.
 Curious about new tools as they ship . You try them, keep the ones that improve the work, and drop the ones that do not, rather than waiting for something to become standard before adopting it.
 Common responsibilities include (but are not limited to):
 Email and lifecycle marketing as the central engine: newsletters, lifecycle automations, segmentation, A/B testing across subject lines, copy, CTAs, send times, and offers. For several of our brands, email is the highest-leverage channel and the place where the biggest wins live.
 Conversion rate optimization across landing pages, sign-up flows, pricing pages, and checkout. Hypothesis, test, read, decide.
 Content and copy production : blog posts, landing pages, email copy, lead magnets, social content. Shipped at velocity with AI leverage.
 Social presence on the channels that matter for your brand. Platform-native treatment, hooks, formats, and pacing tuned to where the content lives.
 Marketing automation workflows in n8n, Make, Zapier, or equivalent. Connecting your tools into systems that run without you.
 Weekly analytics review across GA4, email platform reporting, and channel dashboards. Identifying what is working, iterating on what is not, bringing data-backed ideas to leadership.
 Working closely with the brand General Manager, product team, support, SEO, and the central Awesome Motive growth team.
 Operator background. 5+ years of growth marketing as the only or founding marketer at a B2B SaaS, or as the operator inside a small growth team where you owned full execution.
 Real AI-augmented work . Specific workflows, specific tools used daily, specific outputs that AI made possible. Not "I use ChatGPT for research" but real systems.
 Email and lifecycle depth . You have owned an email program at a SaaS company. You know the metrics that matter and have shipped programs that moved them.
 CRO chops . You have run real experiments on real pages with real data. You can talk through your wins and your losses.
 Full-stack execution . Copy plus landing page plus email plus campaign plus analysis. You can carry a piece of work from idea to live without waiting on anyone.
 Hungry over knowledgeable . You learn new tools quickly, drop old ones without ego, and treat your skill stack as something you upgrade continuously.

 Location: Calgary, Alberta, Canada

 Reports To: Account Manager/Facilities Manager
 Employment Type: Full-time, Regular, On-site 
 About JLL 
 We're JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We help organizations around the world achieve their ambitions by owning, occupying, and investing in real estate. If you're looking to step up your career, JLL is the perfect professional home. With us, you'll develop your skills, expand your network, and shape a brighter way forward for our clients, our people, and our communities. 
 Position Overview 
 JLL is seeking an experienced Facilities Coordinator to support the WestJet account at our Calgary campus location. This dynamic role combines hands-on facility operations with comprehensive administrative coordination, requiring strong organizational skills, technical knowledge of building systems, and excellent vendor management capabilities. The position serves as a critical liaison between operations, vendors, finance, and client stakeholders to ensure seamless facility operations and exceptional service delivery across multiple WestJet sites. This role evolved from a Lead Building Operator position to provide enhanced facilities coordination and administrative support. 
 What This Job Involves 
 Work Order Management & Coordination 
 You'll serve as the central point for all work order activities through the Corrigo system, managing the complete lifecycle from entry through completion. Your responsibilities include entering, routing, and tracking work orders to ensure timely resolution. You'll ensure all work orders have appropriate cost codes attached for accurate budget tracking and attach invoices to completed work orders for processing. Monitoring work order statuses and following up on near-due and unverified work orders will keep operations running smoothly. You'll generate reports for overdue work orders to maintain accountability, create proposals and manage Authorize No Charge approvals, and review Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedules in collaboration with the reliability team. Assigning work orders to operators according to schedule and managing Corrigo scheduling will optimize resource allocation. You'll also complete Fire Life Safety (FLS) Binder documentation from Corrigo work orders to share with the WestJet HSE team, ensuring compliance documentation is current and accessible. 
 Administrative & Operational Support 
 Providing comprehensive administrative support to the Operations Manager and MTS Tech for all non-Calgary sites will be a core function. You'll manage the badging support process including visitor badges and WestJet badging for vendors, maintaining accurate access records. Maintaining emergency call trees with current contact information ensures rapid response capabilities. You'll oversee the uniform program for facility staff, manage vehicle fleet coordination for the account, and prepare MIS (Management Information System) reports for operational data analysis. Managing inventory of office supplies and equipment, creating work orders for equipment and supply purchases, and ordering parts and supplies as needed will support daily operations. You'll research and identify cost-effective solutions including coordinating vendor bids to optimize account spending. Participating in quality walkthroughs such as janitorial inspections and responding promptly to facility-related issues and requests will maintain service standards. 
 Vendor & Contractor Management 
 As the primary liaison with contractors and service providers, you'll coordinate access, work schedules, and quality oversight across all WestJet facilities. Managing the vendor check-in/check-out process ensures security and accountability. You'll maintain current Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs) for all contractor work to support safety compliance. Communicating with vendors regarding invoices and work status keeps projects on track financially and operationally. You'll coordinate with vendors to schedule airport work and arrange necessary escort services for airside access. Managing waste and recycling vendor services supports environmental goals. Assisting with the WestJet badging process for vendors ensures proper credentialing. You'll ensure contractors adhere to safety protocols, building standards, and WestJet requirements, and liaise and schedule with external contractors and vendors for moves and special projects. Processing work orders through the Corrigo system and reviewing and approving contractor work completion and documentation will maintain quality standards. 
 Facility Operations & Maintenance 
 You'll coordinate and oversee daily facility operations for WestJet buildings, ensuring optimal performance of all base building systems. Your responsibilities include monitoring and supporting critical building systems including HVAC, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, Fire Life Safety (FLS), and Building Management Systems (BMS). You'll work with BMS platforms including Desigo, Trane Tracer, and Schneider systems, particularly for data center operations. Supporting boiler and chiller operations to ensure efficient performance and compliance with operational standards will be part of your routine. Coordinating elevator maintenance and compliance inspections, along with collaborating with the reliability team to update asset information in Corrigo, will maintain system integrity. You'll conduct regular site inspections to identify maintenance needs proactively and provide on-call support for after-hours and weekend facility emergencies as required. Acting as backup coverage for building operators during absences or peak demand periods and responding to urgent facility issues while coordinating emergency response with contractors will ensure operational continuity. 
 Compliance & Safety 
 Ensuring compliance with municipal, provincial, and federal regulations related to building operations is critical. You'll work with Reliability Engineers on Preventive Maintenance schedules to meet compliance requirements. Coordinating and tracking mandatory inspections including fire safety, elevator, and racking and storage systems will be routine responsibilities. You'll maintain accurate compliance documentation and inspection records, assist with safety inspections, and organize safety drills to maintain readiness. Supporting health and safety initiatives across all managed facilities and supporting logistics for facility events will promote a safe work environment. 
 Budget & Finance Coordination 
 You'll coordinate with the Finance department on facility-related expenses, ensuring accurate budget tracking and invoice processing. Working with project teams on special project planning and budget considerations will support strategic initiatives. You'll prepare EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) plans for special projects to ensure compliance and safety. Supporting MIS reporting for financial and operational data analysis will provide visibility into account performance and cost management. 
 Event and Space Management 
 Coordinating office moves and space reconfigurations will support WestJet's evolving workplace needs. You'll work with the Operations Manager on layout planning to optimize space utilization. Supporting set-up for facility events and office moves, along with liaising and scheduling with external contractors and vendors for move coordination, will ensure smooth transitions and minimal disruption to operations. 
 Janitorial & Environmental Services 
 Overseeing janitorial services and standards across facilities ensures cleanliness standards meet WestJet and JLL expectations. You'll participate in quality walkthroughs to assess service delivery. Coordinating special cleaning projects and responding to service concerns promptly will maintain high standards. Managing waste and recycling vendor services supports sustainability goals.

 Minimum 3-5 years of facility coordination or building operations experience

DESCRIPTION DE L’ENTREPRISE 
 Ludia est un studio innovant et dynamique, spécialisé dans le développement de jeux mobiles. Basé à Montréal depuis 2007, chaque mois, plus de 3,5 millions de joueurs à travers le monde plongent dans nos univers. Notre portfolio combine des franchises mondiales emblématiques et des créations originales, incluant Jurassic World™ Alive, Jurassic World™: The Game, Dragons: Rise of Berk, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Legends, et bien d’autres.

 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE 
 En tant que Responsable Assurance Qualité (QA) sur Jurassic World Alive, vous serez responsable de définir et de piloter la stratégie qualité d’un jeu mobile live service joué par une communauté mondiale.
 À la tête de l’équipe QA du projet, vous veillerez à ce que les nouvelles fonctionnalités, mises à jour et contenus répondent à nos standards de qualité avant leur mise entre les mains des joueurs. Vous établirez les priorités de test en fonction des risques, assurerez une couverture adéquate des différentes composantes du jeu et fournirez à l’équipe de production une vision claire de la stabilité et de la qualité de chaque version.
 🎯 RESPONSABILITÉS 
 Stratégie QA & Qualité 
 Définir et faire évoluer la stratégie QA du projet en fonction de la roadmap, des priorités de production et des risques.
 Analyser les nouvelles fonctionnalités et changements afin d’identifier les risques, les besoins de validation et la couverture de test appropriée.
 Superviser la création et l’exécution des plans de test pour les fonctionnalités, contenus, systèmes et mises à jour du jeu.
 Assurer une couverture adéquate des différentes composantes du jeu, notamment les interactions client-serveur, sauvegardes et données joueurs, fonctionnalités en ligne, intégration des assets et compatibilité des appareils.
 Veiller à la conformité et à la compatibilité des versions sur les plateformes mobiles iOS et Android.
 Releases & Gestion des Risques 
 Évaluer continuellement la stabilité du jeu et les risques associés aux bugs, nouvelles fonctionnalités et changements apportés au produit.
 Piloter la validation QA des releases et fournir aux parties prenantes une évaluation claire des risques et de la préparation de chaque version avant son déploiement.
 Identifier les enjeux critiques pouvant affecter l’expérience joueur et assurer leur priorisation avec les équipes concernées.
 Contribuer à la planification des releases et communiquer de façon proactive les contraintes, risques et délais de validation.
 Soutenir l’investigation et la résolution des problèmes rencontrés en production et contribuer aux analyses post-release lorsque nécessaire.
 Leadership & Gestion d'Équipe 
 Encadrer et mobiliser l’équipe QA du projet en établissant des priorités, attentes et objectifs clairs.
 Planifier et répartir les efforts de test en fonction de la roadmap, des releases et des capacités de l’équipe.
 Accompagner les membres de l’équipe dans leur développement professionnel par du coaching, du feedback régulier et des objectifs de progression.
 Favoriser une culture de qualité, de responsabilisation et d’amélioration continue au sein de l’équipe.
 Anticiper les besoins en ressources QA et collaborer avec la Production afin d’adapter la capacité de test aux besoins du projet.
 Collaboration & Amélioration Continue 
 Agir comme principal point de contact QA auprès des équipes de développement et de Production.
 Communiquer clairement l’état de qualité du jeu, la progression des tests, les risques identifiés et les enjeux pouvant affecter une release.
 Participer activement à la planification de production et contribuer à établir des échéanciers réalistes en fonction des besoins de validation.
 Collaborer avec les différentes disciplines afin d’intégrer les considérations de qualité plus tôt dans le processus de développement.
 Faire évoluer les processus, outils, métriques et pratiques QA afin d’améliorer l’efficacité, la couverture et la visibilité sur la qualité du projet.
 Contribuer aux initiatives et meilleures pratiques QA à l’échelle du studio.
 QUALIFICATIONS

 5 années et plus d’expérience en Assurance Qualité dans l’industrie du jeu vidéo, dont au moins 2 années dans un rôle de leadership ou de gestion d’équipe QA.
 Expérience significative en développement et en QA de jeux mobiles, idéalement sur un produit live service.
 Expérience dans la planification et la coordination de cycles de test complexes et de releases régulières.
 Solide compréhension des processus de développement de jeux et de l’intégration de fonctionnalités dans un environnement de production Agile.
 Bonne compréhension des environnements iOS et Android, incluant les enjeux de compatibilité, de déploiement et de validation propres aux plateformes mobiles.
 Bonne compréhension des architectures et enjeux liés aux jeux connectés : client-serveur, données joueurs, sauvegardes, services backend et fonctionnalités en ligne.
 Capacité à analyser et prioriser les bugs selon leur sévérité, leur impact joueur et le niveau de risque pour une release.
 Expérience avec des outils de gestion de bugs, de tests et de production tels que Jira ou des outils équivalents.
 Expérience avec les méthodologies Agile / Scrum.
 💡 Traits Additionels 
 Leadership mobilisateur et capacité à développer, accompagner et responsabiliser une équipe QA.
 Excellent jugement et capacité à prendre des décisions fondées sur le risque, particulièrement dans un contexte de production et de release.
 Excellentes aptitudes en planification, organisation et gestion des priorités dans un environnement où plusieurs initiatives avancent simultanément.
 Approche proactive axée sur la résolution de problèmes et l’amélioration continue.
 Excellentes aptitudes en communication et capacité à présenter clairement les enjeux de qualité et les risques à différentes parties prenantes.
 Capacité à collaborer efficacement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires et à influencer les décisions sans être propriétaire de toutes les disciplines concernées.
 Souci du détail tout en conservant une vision globale de la qualité du produit et de l’expérience joueur.

 POURQUOI LUDIA ?

 👓 Flexibilité : Options hybrides, horaire flexible et un studio vibrant au cœur du Vieux-Montréal.

DCHC ensures Durham community members receive not only sick care, but preventive care as well.
 At DCHC, we are a team-based interprofessional group of staff including physicians, nurse practitioners, nurses, counselors, dietitians, outreach workers, medical secretaries, and other administrative staff. We always place every client at the centre of our approach to care, based on their needs. We address these needs through integrated clinical and wellness care and health education.
 It's an exciting time to be joining this organization.  Durham Community Health Centre has been selected as the lead agency for the new Homeless Addiction Recovery Treatment (HART) Hub in the Durham region.  This innovative hub will provide life-changing services for individuals struggling with addiction and mental health challenges, helping them regain stability and rebuild their futures. The Hart Hub is a 24/7 operation, providing continuous support to the community.

 As a member of an interdisciplinary team, the Nurse Practitioner (NP) will deliver comprehensive, client-centered primary care and addiction-focused health services to individuals experiencing homelessness and/or substance use challenges in the community.

 Actively participate, seek, and provide consultation within an inter-professional model of care 
 Perform clinical assessments and health information gathering for clients with complex needs 
 Provide nursing services that address the biopsychosocial needs of clients, including clients with multiple comorbid health conditions, mental health diagnoses and/or concurrent disorders involving substance use/abuse. 
 Perform intake assessment activities for new clients 
 Contribute to providing more accessible targeted services to community members within high-priority populations, including the homeless population and individuals recovering from Addictions, through direct service, referrals, and navigation. 
 Complete timely and accurate medical records of client encounters, documentation and third-party correspondence using DCHC’s Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system. 
 Support client safety through evidence-based practices and adherence to policies and standards including communication and teamwork, infection prevention and control, safe medication practices, safe use of equipment and facilities, and risk reporting. 
 Contribute to activities related to the development, implementation and evaluation of medical directives, policies and procedures, best-practices, and protocols. 
 Adhere to and promote evidence-based practices and standards of best-practice in keeping with DCHC clinic operational guidelines. 
 Actively participate in case conferences when required.

Cohere's North team is seeking a Software Engineer with a focus on security to join our mission and make a significant impact. As a Senior Software Engineer with a security focus, you'll play a pivotal role in building and securing North's architecture. Your responsibilities will include:

 - Software Development: Contributing to the core development of security features such as OIDC/OAuth flows and session management, ensuring North's AI agents are secure

 - Authentication and Data Protection: Implementing authentication mechanisms including user login, token management, and authorization checks to maintain data integrity

 - Tool Integration: Pulling in new tools to enhance North's security capabilities

 - DevSecOps: Design and implement secret management within Kubernetes clusters, including encryption and RBAC

 - Cross-functional Collaboration: Demonstrate strong soft skills to communicate security best practices to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner


You may be a good fit if:

 - Have 5+ years building user-facing security features in production systems

 - Ship production Python confidently and frequently

 - Understand OIDC/OAuth 2.0, JWT validation, and token lifecycle management deeply—not just conceptually

 - Have hands-on experience with Kubernetes in both development and production environments

 - Have worked across GCP, AWS, Azure, or hybrid/multi-cloud deployments

 - Are comfortable working across the stack

 - Communicate security concepts clearly to non-security engineers and stakeholders

 - Thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve

 - Experience working with AI/ML systems or LLM-based applications

   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 Le Launchpad de Mila Ventures est un pilier du soutien à l'entrepreneuriat chez Mila. Le programme offre aux entreprises en IA des bases solides en proposant aux chercheurs-fondateurs et aux fondateurs un point d'entrée bien encadré vers l'entrepreneuriat, avec accès à la communauté, au mentorat, à des ressources techniques et à l'écosystème de Mila Ventures. Launchpad soutient des startups spécialisées en IA native, en IA appliquée et en technologies de pointe (deep tech), allant d'entreprises bâties sur des modèles d'apprentissage automatique et des ensembles de données propriétaires à celles appliquant l'IA avancée pour résoudre des problèmes industriels ou développant des technologies transformatrices basées sur des percées scientifiques majeures.
 En tant qu'analyste, vous contribuerez aux opérations quotidiennes du programme Launchpad. Vous établirez des liens de confiance avec la communauté de recherche de Mila, produirez des documents essentiels pour soutenir le processus de sélection et entretiendrez des relations avec les équipes lors du lancement de leur startup. Une partie importante de ce rôle consistera également à concevoir des flux de travail d'IA agentique afin d'améliorer nos efficiences opérationnelles et de nous permettre de passer à l'échelle.
 Vos responsabilités 
 Tisser de véritables relations au sein de la communauté de recherche de Mila, afin que les professeurs et chercheurs voient l'entrepreneuriat comme une opportunité sérieuse et non comme un projet secondaire.
 Sourcer, recruter et intégrer les nouvelles entreprises du Launchpad, en soutenant leur croissance à un moment critique de leur trajectoire.
 Soutenir le processus du comité de sélection du Launchpad en rédigeant des notes d'analyse (memos) et en préparant les présentations des fondateurs.
 Bâtir avec des LLM : identifier les frictions opérationnelles, concevoir et créer des outils ou flux de travail utilisant les LLM pour soutenir les opérations transversales des programmes.
 Suivre les indicateurs clés : création d'entreprises, adhésions au Launchpad, fonds levés.
 Coordonner les événements et la logistique des rencontres sociales entre fondateurs.
 Proposer des idées et des solutions pour mieux répondre aux besoins de nos fondateurs selon leurs commentaires.
 Profil recherché 
 Analyste — 1 à 3 ans d'expérience, avec une autonomie sur les projets et des résultats tangibles.
 À l'aise d'utiliser les LLM comme outil quotidien : ingénierie de requêtes (prompting), enchaînement d'outils, automatisation légère, etc.
 Expérience préalable dans l'écosystème du capital-risque, des hautes technologies ou des startups est un atout majeur.
 Curiosité sincère pour l'IA, les technologies de pointe et la recherche.
 Grand dynamisme, autonomie, motivation, aisance relationnelle et orientation vers la mission. Personne proactive qui aime résoudre des problèmes.
 Bonne capacité d'évaluation des personnes : vous savez rapidement si un profil opérationnel et un chercheur travailleront bien ensemble.
 Bilinguisme français/anglais est un plus.

 Analyst, Launchpad
 About Mila 
 Founded by Professor Yoshua Bengio of the Université de Montréal, Mila brings together researchers specializing in artificial intelligence, and more specifically in machine learning, deep learning and reinforcement learning. Recognized worldwide for its important contributions to the field of deep learning, Mila has particularly distinguished itself in language modeling, machine translation, object recognition and generative models. Since 2017, Mila has been the fruit of a collaboration between Université de Montréal and McGill University, with close links to Polytechnique Montréal and HEC Montréal.
 Mila's mission is to be a global hub of scientific advances that inspires innovation and the rise of artificial intelligence (AI) for the benefit of all.
 To find out more, please visit  https://mila.quebec/ 
 About the role 
 The Mila Ventures Launchpad has been a cornerstone of Mila's entrepreneurship support. The program gives AI ventures a strong early-stage foundation by offering founder researchers and founders a supportive entry point into entrepreneurship, with access to community, mentorship, technical resources, and the Mila Ventures ecosystem. Launchpad supports AI-native, applied AI, and deep tech startups, ranging from companies built on proprietary machine learning models and datasets, to those applying advanced AI to solve industry problems, or developing transformative technologies based on major scientific breakthroughs.
 As Analyst, you will contribute to the ongoing operations of the Launchpad program. You’ll build trust with the Mila research community, produce program critical materials to support the selection process and foster relationships with teams as they launch their startups. There will also be a considerable part of this role that is related to building agentic AI workflows to improve our operational efficiencies and allow us to scale the Launchpad program. 
 What you'll do 
 Build real relationships inside the Mila research community, so professors and researchers see entrepreneurship as a serious opportunity, not a side project.
 Source, recruit and onboard new Launchpad companies, supporting their growth at a critical moment of their startup trajectory. 
 Support the Launchpad selection committee process by drafting memos and preparing founder pitches.
 Build with LLMs: identify operational frictions, design and build workflows or tools that use LLMs to support cross program operations.
 Own the numbers: venture creation, Launchpad signings, money raised. 
 Event and logistical coordination for founder social gatherings. 
 Ideate and propose solutions to better meet the needs of our founders’ based on their feedback.
 What we're looking for 
 Analyst — 1-3 years of experience, with project ownership and impactful results. 
 Comfortable using LLMs as a daily tool across many kinds of work: prompting, chaining tools together, light automation, etc
 Previous exposure to the VC, high tech or startup ecosystem is a great fit here. 
 Genuine curiosity about AI, frontier technologies and research.
 High energy, autonomous, driven, sociable, and mission-driven. Self-starter who likes to problem solve.
 Strong judgment about people: you can tell quickly whether an operator and a researcher will actually work well together.
